_how_to_use: Save as confidential/rules.json (it contains people's names). Terms are lowercase; accents and punctuation are ignored ('AT&T' = 'at t'). They match whole words; end with * for a prefix (lumber* matches lumberyard); 'word #' means the word followed by a number. User rules run first, the first match wins. Category names: built-in English or Portuguese labels, keys (owner_draw, contractors, payroll, supplies, transfer, card_payment, loan_in, commissions, cust_deposits, chargebacks), or any new name.
_como_usar: Salve em confidencial/regras.json (tem nomes de pessoas). Use 'despesas'/'receitas' ou 'expenses'/'income'. Termos em minúsculas, sem acento; casam por palavra inteira; * no fim casa prefixo.
